steps.title: Solid line nearest you
steps.body: Double white lines, nearest line solid: you must not cross or straddle it except in a few specific cases.

question.prompt: You may cross a solid white centre line to…

options.text: Overtake any vehicle slower than you
Save time when the road looks clear
Pass a pedal cycle moving at 10 mph or less

question.explanation: Exceptions: entering premises or a side road, or passing a cycle, horse or works vehicle at 10 mph or less.

a.label: Nearest line solid
a.body: Don't cross or straddle it except for the listed exceptions.

b.label: Nearest line broken
b.body: You may cross to overtake if it's safe and you finish before a solid line starts.

question.prompt: Double white lines with a broken line on your side. You may…

options.text: Cross freely — the lines are only advisory
Never cross for any reason
Cross to overtake if safe, finishing before the solid line starts

question.explanation: A broken line on your side allows overtaking if you can complete it safely in time.

a.label: Broken border
a.body: Don't enter the hatched area unless it's necessary and safe.

b.label: Solid border
b.body: Must not enter except in an emergency.

question.prompt: A hatched area bordered by solid white lines — you may enter…

options.text: Whenever you are overtaking
Only in an emergency
Any time traffic is slow

question.explanation: Solid borders mean keep out except in an emergency; broken borders mean only if necessary and safe.

steps.title: Yellow box junctions
steps.body: Don't enter the box unless your exit road is clear.

question.prompt: You may wait inside a box junction when…

options.text: Queueing straight ahead behind slow traffic
Never — the box must always stay empty
Turning right, blocked only by oncoming traffic or other right-turners

question.explanation: The right-turn wait is the one exception to keeping the box clear.

steps.title: Cats' eyes colour code
steps.body: White studs mark lanes or the road centre. Red: left edge. Amber: right edge or central reservation. Green: slip roads and lay-bys.

question.prompt: Driving at night you see red studs on your left. They mark…

options.text: The left-hand edge of the carriageway
A slip road ahead
The central reservation

question.explanation: Red = left edge. Amber = right edge, white = lanes, green = slip roads and lay-bys.

steps.scene: You're turning right in a yellow box junction. Your exit is clear, but oncoming traffic stops you completing the turn.

options.text: Reverse back out of the box
Wait in the box until a gap lets you finish the turn
You should never have entered the box

question.explanation: Waiting to turn right, held up only by oncoming traffic, is the permitted exception.

questions.prompt: The centre line nearest you is solid white. Crossing it is…

options.text: Allowed only for exceptions like passing a cycle at 10 mph or less
Allowed at night when it's quiet
Allowed to overtake anything slower

questions.explanation: Solid nearest line: don't cross except for the specific listed exceptions.

questions.prompt: When may you cross double white lines with a broken line on your side?

options.text: Never — they count as solid
To overtake if safe and you finish before your line turns solid
Only to enter a driveway

questions.explanation: Broken on your side: overtaking is allowed when safe and completed in time.

questions.prompt: A hatched area with a broken border — when may you enter?

options.text: Never, in any circumstances
Any time — it's a normal lane
Only if it is necessary and safe

questions.explanation: Broken border: don't enter unless necessary and safe. Solid border: emergencies only.

questions.prompt: Going straight ahead, you may enter a box junction only when…

options.text: The vehicle ahead starts to move
Your exit road is clear
The lights are green, whatever the exit looks like

questions.explanation: Green light or not: enter the box only when your exit is clear.

options.text: Slip-road entries and exits, and lay-bys
The middle of the road
The right-hand edge of the carriageway

questions.explanation: Green = slip roads and lay-bys. White = lanes, red = left edge, amber = right edge.
